title: A Machine for the Orbit
author: Ines Quintana
blurb: Bram Halloran, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
